title: Understanding the Data
text: The table shows the time spent by a visitor at each exhibit. Each column represents a different exhibit, and the values are the time spent in minutes. Consider how this data might be used in PCA to find patterns or reduce dimensions.

title: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
text: PCA is used to reduce the dimensionality of data while preserving as much variance as possible. It transforms the data into a new coordinate system where the greatest variance comes to lie on the first coordinate (called the first principal component), the second greatest variance on the second coordinate, and so on.
